evals.prompt: This Apps Script loops through 50,000 rows, calls getValue and setValue for every cell, and times out. Optimize it without changing results.
evals.expected_output: Instrumentation, batched range operations, in-memory maps, chunk/continuation only if still needed, idempotency, realistic benchmarks, and capacity risks.

evals.prompt: An HTML Service dashboard makes 18 google.script.run calls at startup and feels slow. Some reference data changes hourly and some rows are user-private.
evals.expected_output: A measured call graph, composed view models, safe identity-aware cache decisions, pagination, parallelism boundaries, loading UX, and before/after evidence.
